acceptance: `evolve dossier sweep --dry-run` lists a fixture's dirty complete pair and commits nothing (red: unknown subcommand)
Without --dry-run it commits the pair and leaves a half pair; a live run lease exits 1
fix: Add `evolve dossier sweep [--dry-run]`, calling SweepOrphans under the ship lock and live-run check that `dossier publish` uses, and printing the recommitted, skipped and failed cycles. --dry-run lists the pairs it would commit and commits nothing. Exit 0; 1 when held or when any pair failed; 2 on I/O. It lands after dossier-sweep-pairing fixes the pairing. Document it next to `dossier publish` in runtime-reference.md.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: dossier.SweepOrphans recommits every complete dirty cycle-N.{json,md} pair in the tree and skips half pairs (internal/dossier/sweep.go:26-30); only its tests call it. When a closeout leaves a dossier pair dirty in the plane outside .evolve/dossiers-pending, the operator commits it with raw git. Its pairing matches by cycle number anywhere in the repo, so two same-numbered files in different directories become one pair (inbox dossier-sweep-pairing).
title: Orphan dossier pairs left dirty in the tree are committed with raw git, while SweepOrphans exists with no caller; add `evolve dossier sweep`
